refnamediv.refpurpose: Call a callback with an array of parameters, preserving the current called class

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
mixedforward_static_call_array callablecallback arrayargs
Calls a user defined function or method given by the callback parameter, with arguments passed as an array, similarly to call_user_func_array. When called from within a method context and calling a method callback, it forwards the current late static binding, so static:: inside the method resolves to the current called class. This is useful for static method callbacks that should behave like forwarding calls such as parent:: or self::.
Unlike forward_static_call, this function does not require an active class scope: calling forward_static_call outside a class throws an Error, while this function does not.

&reftitle.parameters;
callback
The function or method to be called. This parameter may be an &array;, with the name of the class, and the method, or a &string;, with a function name.
args
The parameters to be passed to the callback, as an array.
To pass a parameter by reference, the corresponding element in args must be a reference.

&reftitle.returnvalues;
Returns the function result, or &false; on error.
